purpose: General compact-text inspection and existing-context-recovery coverage for read-only tool stages.
change: Reference text supports inclusive Unicode column windows, default1–1000 per selected line, reporting full line lengths and sliced line IDs. Larger windows and end_column:null remain available; no API token/input/response cap was added. Full-file hash/size verification still precedes returning any fragment.
recovery: Reuse the existing explicit context restart for inspection-tool sessions as well as shell sessions. Keep original instructions, latest candidate/patch/feedback chain, request ledger and deadline; do not replay completed actions or execute partial responses. No recovery for unchanged original input, authentication/server/uncertain transport failures or preparation-only sessions.

checks.quality: Root/explicit experimental Ruff and format,ty,required hooks passed.

development_failures: Recovery fixture initially had no history large enough to reduce; then it retained mutable payload references. Updated the synthetic large-observation fixture and copied captured requests. One format adjustment followed. Original live task/source/artifacts were unchanged.
